strapiBlog.title: 5 Best Places to Get your Home Décor in Dubai

data.text:
Apart from the location and configuration, one thing that plays a vital role in determining the value of a home is its décor. Needless to say, a beautifully decorated home will attract more buyers.

Even if you do not wish to sell your home, improving the décor of your home can prove to be beneficial in many ways. Right off the bat, it will make your home look more appealing and luxurious. Depending on the décor and theme you have opted for, it will add an element of personalization to your home and make it stand out among the rest. Furthermore, it can help you de-stress as well. Not a lot of people know that interior design impacts our happiness and well-being.

Having said that, it can be a complicated procedure to establish or improve your home’s décor. Among the different steps the entire process entails, the most challenging aspect is to find the right place to get home décor items. And for this, we have got you covered. In this article, we presenting you with a list of the 5 best luxury home decor places in Dubai. Take a look at them:

5 Best Luxury Home Décor Places in Dubai

1. Marina Homes

Having multiple outlets in the emirate, Marina Homes is one of the most popular names for home décor and furnishing products. You can find here classic pieces that can enhance the entire look and appeal of your home.

It is a one-stop-shop for durable, premium quality and aesthetically appealing lifestyle, furniture and furnishing items. From faux plants to wall clocks, lamps to side tables and accessories, they have a huge variety to choose from. This brand also operates in the Indian subcontinent.

2. Zara Homes

A name to reckon with, Zara is a go-to choice of many for high-quality home décor items that fall under the mid-range budget category. The brand has a huge selection of sophisticated and modern goods, including bed covers, linen tablecloths, decorative cushions, etc. You should particularly check out the furniture articles and lamps available at Zara.

Zara has outlets located in The Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, Mercato Mall and Jumeirah Beach Residences.

3. Pottery Barn

Although Pottery Barn is famous for its exclusive range of furniture, you can also find the most beautiful décor items here. The articles available here present a unique blend of classic and modern designs that can give your abode a lavish look. Particularly, if you are looking for stylish lamps and other bedroom accessories, Pottery Barn has got you covered.

It is located in The Dubai Mall and Mirdif City.

4. Bloomingdale’s

Bloomingdale’s is primarily a fashion store. It is known for affordable apparels and accessories for men, women and kids. However, lately, it has also become a preferable choice of many home décor items. Under the ‘home & tech’ section, you would find an array of home décor items that are affordable yet classy and appealing.

Bloomingdale’s has a complete collection of top-notch products from exclusive bathroom accessories to bedroom décor items, including lamps, artwork and paintings, mirrors and rugs. You can also order online and get same-day delivery.

Bloomingdale’s home store is located in The Dubai Mall.

5. Gautier

If you are looking for French-style decorative items, Gautier is your ultimate option. Located in Al Safa 2, it has become a popular choice for those looking for elegant furniture articles and classy decor pieces.

Lighting fixtures, rugs, mirrors and vases – these are some of the categories for home décor products available at Gautier. The best part about Gautier products is that they have a distinct design that sets them apart from other run-of-the-mill items.

Final Thoughts

In a nutshell, it’s safe to say that working on your home décor can add value to your property in Dubai, be it a villa, apartment or townhouse. You can easily find top décor ideas to transform the look of your home and convert it into a luxurious abode that you had always dreamed of living in. And for the items required for this purpose can be found in the aforementioned home décor stores quite conveniently. These stores have their catalogues and listings online. Therefore, you can shop right from the comfort of your home and get décor items delivered at your doorsteps.
